Container.Name: ThunderHub
Container.Overview: ThunderHub is an open-source Lightning Network node manager with a browser interface for monitoring and managing LND or Lightning Terminal nodes, channels, payments, on-chain wallet activity, Taproot Assets, swaps, and multi-node accounts.
Container.Requires: ThunderHub needs access to your LND or LiTD gRPC endpoint and credentials. By default this template stores account config in /data/thubConfig.yaml; edit that file under the Data path or configure the SSO variables. The Docker image runs as a non-root user, so mounted config, macaroon, and certificate files must be readable by the container.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port. Container port: 3000.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores ThunderHub account config, optional cookie, and optional SQLite database files.

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: Interface ThunderHub listens on inside the container.

Config.Name: Account Config Path
Config.Description: Path to the ThunderHub YAML account config inside the container. ThunderHub can create this file if the Data path is writable.

Config.Name: Master Password Override
Config.Description: Optional password override used for all YAML accounts.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level, for example error, warn, info, debug, or verbose.

Config.Name: Theme
Config.Description: Default interface theme. Use dark or light.

Config.Name: Currency
Config.Description: Default currency display, for example sat, btc, or usd.

Config.Name: Mempool URL
Config.Description: Mempool API base URL used for fee and block data.

Config.Name: Tor Proxy
Config.Description: Optional SOCKS proxy used for outbound connections, for example socks://127.0.0.1:9050.

Config.Name: Fetch Prices
Config.Description: Fetch exchange price data. Set to false to disable.

Config.Name: Fetch Fees
Config.Description: Fetch fee recommendation data. Set to false to disable.

Config.Name: Disable External Links
Config.Description: Disable external links in the interface. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Disable Version Check
Config.Description: Disable checks against the latest GitHub release. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Disable All Subscriptions
Config.Description: Disable all Lightning realtime subscriptions. Use true or false.

Config.Name: LND Data
Config.Description: Optional read-only mount for an LND data directory. YAML accounts can use lndDir: /lnd.

Config.Name: LiTD Data
Config.Description: Optional read-only mount for a Lightning Terminal data directory. YAML accounts can use litDir: /lit.

Config.Name: SSO Server URL
Config.Description: Optional SSO node gRPC address, for example 192.168.1.10:10009 or lnd:10009.

Config.Name: SSO Certificate Path
Config.Description: Optional SSO TLS certificate path inside the container, for example /lnd/tls.cert.

Config.Name: SSO Macaroon Directory
Config.Description: Optional directory containing admin.macaroon for SSO, for example /lnd/data/chain/bitcoin/mainnet.

Config.Name: SSO Node Type
Config.Description: SSO node type. Use lnd or litd.

Config.Name: Dangerous No SSO Auth
Config.Description: Allow SSO without auth. Only use behind trusted access controls. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Cookie Path
Config.Description: Optional persistent cookie secret path. Keep this in the Data path if enabled.

Config.Name: YAML Env 1
Config.Description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_1}.

Config.Name: YAML Env 2
Config.Description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_2}.

Config.Name: YAML Env 3
Config.Description: Optional secret value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_3}.

Config.Name: YAML Env 4
Config.Description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_4}.

Config.Name: Database Type
Config.Description: Optional database backend. Leave blank to disable, or use sqlite or postgres.

Config.Name: SQLite Database Path
Config.Description: SQLite database path used when Database Type is sqlite.

Config.Name: Postgres URL
Config.Description: Postgres connection URL used when Database Type is postgres.

Config.Name: Database Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional 64-character hex key for encrypting node credentials at rest.
